subject: Madelyn's attempt as a logo (#251)
reason: The change only swaps the ASCII art logo string in src/asciilogo.h, printed to the log at startup. The printf-style format specifiers (%s (%s/%d) %s bit, %s mode, Port: %d, PID: %ld) are unchanged in kind and order, so the banner rendering code remains correct. No command behaviour, replies, replication, persistence, or any other runtime path changes; nothing a fuzzer scenario could exercise.
